# Auto-generated standalone model file
import numpy as np
import scipy.special
from tvb.basic.neotraits.api import Attr, Final, List, NArray, Range
from tvb.simulator.models.base import Model


class KuramotoModel2(Model):

    omega = NArray(
        label=r":math:`omega`",
        default=np.array([1.0]),
        domain=Range(lo=0.01, hi=200.0, step=0.1),
        doc="""Sets the base line frequency for the Kuramoto oscillator in [rad/ms].""",
    )

    _nvar = 1
    state_variables = ["theta"]

    state_variable_range = Final(
        label="State Variable ranges [lo, hi]",
        default={"theta": np.array([0.0, 6.283185307179586])},
        doc="""Expected ranges of the state variables for initial condition generation and phase plane setup.""",
    )

    variables_of_interest = List(
        of=str,
        label="Variables watched by Monitors",
        choices=("theta", "phase", "signal"),
        default=("theta", "phase", "signal"),
        doc="""Default state variables to be monitored.""",
    )

    parameter_names = List(
        of=str,
        label="List of parameters for this model",
        default=["omega"],
    )

    local_parameter_names = []

    state_variable_dfuns = Final(
        label="Drift functions",
        default={
            "theta": "I + omega",
        },
    )

    cvar = np.array([0], dtype=np.int32)

    coupling_terms = Final(label="Coupling terms", default=["c_glob"])

    _R = None
    _stimulus = 0.0
    use_numba = False

    def update_derived_parameters(self):

        omega = self.omega

        self.f = f = 500 * omega / np.pi

    def _build_observer(self):
        template = (
            "def observe(state):\n"
            "    {svars} = state\n"
            "    phase = (1/2)*theta/np.pi\n"
            "    signal = np.sin(theta)\n"
            "    return numpy.array([{voi_names}])"
        )
        svars = ",".join(self.state_variables)
        if len(self.state_variables) == 1:
            svars += ","
        code = template.format(
            svars=svars, voi_names=",".join(self.variables_of_interest)
        )
        namespace = {"numpy": np, "np": np, "pi": np.pi, "sin": np.sin}
        namespace.update(self.__dict__)
        self.log.debug("building observer with code:\n%s", code)
        exec(code, namespace)
        self.observe = namespace["observe"]
        self.observe.code = code

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        theta = state_variables[0, :]

        omega = self.omega

        f = self.f

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        c_glob = coupling[0, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.lc_0 = lc_0 = np.sin(local_coupling * theta)
        self.phase = phase = (1 / 2) * theta / np.pi
        self.signal = signal = np.sin(theta)
        self.I = I = c_glob + lc_0

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(I + omega),  # theta
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
